Package Group3.controller

Class MealFoodController

java.lang.Object
Group3.controller.MealFoodController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/meal-foods") public class MealFoodController extends Object
Controller responsible for managing relationships between meals and foods. Provides endpoints to: - Retrieve all meal-food relationships - Retrieve a specific meal-food entry - Create, update, and delete meal-food entries
